paper.title_en: Search for Electric Dipole Moments and Axions/ALPS with Polarized Hadron Beams in Storage Rings
paper.abstract_en: The project aims to address two major open questions of contemporary physics - why antimatter disappeared after the Big Bang and what dark matter is - by testing fundamental symmetries through searches for electric dipole moments (EDMs) of charged hadrons. Using polarized beams in storage rings, it targets both permanent and oscillating EDMs of protons, deuterons, and possibly helium-3, which would signal physics beyond the Standard Model. Following the milestones achieved at the COSY ring, the research will focus on developing a prototype storage ring, in both all-electric and hybrid (electric + magnetic) versions, to reach unprecedented sensitivity. Success will enable a future large-scale precision facility capable of improving current nucleonEDM limits by up to three orders of magnitude. This program has the potential to open a new precision frontier in fundamental symmetry tests and dark matter searches.
